_about: Base food compositions transcribed from published quantitative studies (units ug/kg as reported). Every value comes from the cited table; nothing is estimated. Compounds without an accepted water threshold are kept here for transparency but excluded from the model (see prepare_data.py).

bases.name_zh: 常温酸奶（高酸度原料奶批次）

source.citation: Wang J, Zhang D, Li J, Zou T, Wen R, Hou Y, Song H, Li H, Ma H, Shi J. Aroma profiling of long shelf-life yoghurt from milk with varying acidity: insights from sensory evaluation and instrumental analysis. Food Chem X 2025.

bases.note: Acetaldehyde was not quantified in this study.

source.citation: Xu K, Han H, Wang X, Zhang X, Yang X, Lu X, Han Z, Wang S, Wang Y, et al. Elucidation of key aroma-active compounds and sensory profiles in raw and thermally sterilized milks: perspective from molecular sensory science. Food Chem X 2026.
source.table: Table 3 (SIDA) where available, otherwise Table 2 (external standard)
source.method: SIDA for 8 compounds; external standard for the others

bases.note: For compounds measured by both methods the two values differ by up to ~9x (e.g. butanoic acid in raw milk); SIDA values are used where available.

bases.name_en: Young Gouda cheese, 4 weeks ripened (pasteurized milk)
bases.name_zh: 年轻豪达奶酪（巴氏奶制，成熟 4 周）

source.citation: Duensing PW, Hinrichs J, Schieberle P. Formation of key aroma compounds during 30 weeks of ripening in Gouda-type cheese produced from pasteurized and raw milk. J Agric Food Chem 2024.

bases.note: Concentrations are on a dry-matter basis; the paper does not report the water content needed to convert them. Replaces the plant-based yoghurt example (user decision): the only available quantitative study (Nijdam et al. 2025) quantified three compounds and none of the plant-derived odorants.
